ouch.name: #Ouch
ouch.lanes: Four perpendicular lanes forming a pound (#) sign around a central water square
ouch.gimmick: Four separate crossing paths forming a grid around a central square water reservoir

Easy.overview: Four straight tracks intersecting like a tic-tac-toe / pound sign around a square pond. The central pond touches all four track intersections.
Easy.camo_handling: Quincy covers early camos from the upper-left quadrant. Monkey Sub 2-0-0 in the central pond covers all four paths.
Easy.lead_handling: Sniper 1-0-0 or Sub 0-3-0 pops Leads on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Monkey Sub 2-0-4 Armor Piercing Darts in the center pond + Sniper 3-0-2 on Strong destroys the Round 40 MOAB.
Easy.why_it_works: The central square pond touches all four paths, allowing naval towers to cover the entire grid.

Easy.best_hero_reason: #Ouch has four disconnected quadrant tracks and heavy water/sight obstacles; Psi targets bloons across all lanes simultaneously with infinite range.
Easy.hero_synergies: Ninja Monkey (4-0-1) + Alchemist (4-2-0) in center cross

Medium.overview: Medium difficulty tests defense scalability through Round 60 with standard 1.0x pricing. On #Ouch, Quincy secures our early game. The strategy expands into a 2-2-0 Village and 4-2-0 Alchemist buff engine, supporting Recursive Cluster and MOAB Assassin to conquer Round 50 Dual MOABs and shatter the Round 60 BFB.
Medium.camo_handling: Quincy and early detection handle R24/33/36. A 2-2-0 Monkey Village (Radar Scanner) is placed by Round 42, ensuring all towers pop R42 Camo Rainbows, R51 Camo ceramics, and R59 Camo Leads.
Medium.lead_handling: Acidic Mixture Dip (Alchemist 2-0-0) neutralizes early leads on R28/30. Recursive Cluster (2-0-4 Bomb) wipes Round 45 Fortified Leads and Round 59 Camo Leads under Village radar.
Medium.moab_handling: Round 40 MOAB is dispatched via single-target focus. Round 50 Dual MOABs are crushed by Stronger Stimulant buffed clusters. Round 60 BFB is neutralized via MOAB Assassin missile ability.
Medium.why_it_works: Jungle Drums + Stronger Stimulant delivers massive uptime and DPS multipliers across all towers. Radar Scanner gives full camo coverage so no specialized decamo micro is required.

Hard.overview: Hard difficulty demands comprehensive defense across 80 rounds with 1.08x prices. On #Ouch, Quincy secures our early survival starting on Round 3. We establish Ring of Fire and Recursive Cluster for Round 63/76 ceramic rushes, Relentless Glue for lockdown, and crown our defense with a Tier 5 blimp destroyer to vanquish the massive Round 80 ZOMG.
Hard.camo_handling: Early camo is dispatched via Quincy and Ninja detection. A 2-2-0 Monkey Village (Radar Scanner) is placed at the primary track hub, granting universal camo detection to all defenses for R59 Camo Leads and R78 Camo Ceramics.
Hard.lead_handling: Acidic Mixture Dip (Alchemist 2-0-0) neutralizes R28/30 Leads. Recursive Cluster (2-0-4) shreds R45 Fortified Leads. Village MIB/Radar ensures 100% lead-popping uptime on all attackers.
Hard.moab_handling: R40 MOAB and R50 Dual MOABs are conquered via focused single-target fire and Berserker Brew buffs. Round 60 BFB is shattered by targeted missile strikes. Round 80 ZOMG is systematically destroyed by Tier 5 firepower.
Hard.why_it_works: The strategy layers crowd control (0-2-4 Relentless Glue), heavy AoE splash (4-0-2 Tack / 2-0-4 Bomb), and endgame Tier 5 anti-blimp dominance inside a Jungle Drums / Stronger Stimulant buff pocket.
research_sources: Bloons TD 6 Advanced Waves & ZOMG Breakdown

adoras_temple.name: Adora's Temple
adoras_temple.lanes: Single path ascending temple terraces around water basins
adoras_temple.gimmick: Tiered pyramid steps block lower vision; central water pools allow Sub/Buccaneer

Easy.overview: A grand stepped pyramid temple honoring the Sun God. The track climbs the tiers of the pyramid, offering elevated platforms and water basins.
Easy.camo_handling: Ninja 3-0-1 placed on the pyramid steps or Sub 2-0-0 in the temple basin handles all camo bloons.

Easy.moab_handling: Ninja 4-0-1 Bloonjitsu + 3-2-0 Alchemist + 0-3-2 Bomb Shooter easily destroys the Round 40 MOAB on the temple steps.
Easy.why_it_works: The tiered stairs force bloons to loop around the central altar, giving towers multiple firing passes.

alpine_run.name: Alpine Run
alpine_run.lanes: Single serpentine path winding down a snow-covered mountain
alpine_run.gimmick: Series of gentle S-curves down a mountain slope with pine trees

Easy.overview: A winding mountain ski slope with gentle snowy S-bends. Towers positioned inside the hairpins get extended firing time across two adjacent track lanes.

Easy.moab_handling: Bloonjitsu Ninja (4-0-1) + Berserker Brew Alchemist + Bomb 0-3-0 shatters the Round 40 MOAB on the first slope.
Easy.why_it_works: The serpentine curves force bloons to weave back and forth, allowing seeking shurikens and bombs to hit them continuously.

Easy.why_it_works: Towers placed in the center hit bloons continuously for almost 90% of the round duration.

Hard.overview: Hard difficulty demands comprehensive defense across 80 rounds with 1.08x prices. On Bloonarius Prime, Sauda secures our early survival starting on Round 3. We establish Ring of Fire and Recursive Cluster for Round 63/76 ceramic rushes, Relentless Glue for lockdown, and crown our defense with a Tier 5 blimp destroyer to vanquish the massive Round 80 ZOMG.
Hard.camo_handling: Early camo is dispatched via Sauda and Ninja detection. A 2-2-0 Monkey Village (Radar Scanner) is placed at the primary track hub, granting universal camo detection to all defenses for R59 Camo Leads and R78 Camo Ceramics.
Hard.lead_handling: Acidic Mixture Dip (Alchemist 2-0-0) neutralizes R28/30 Leads. Recursive Cluster (2-0-4) shreds R45 Fortified Leads. Village MIB/Radar ensures 100% lead-popping uptime on all attackers.
Hard.moab_handling: R40 MOAB and R50 Dual MOABs are conquered via focused single-target fire and Berserker Brew buffs. Round 60 BFB is shattered by targeted missile strikes. Round 80 ZOMG is systematically destroyed by Tier 5 firepower.
Hard.why_it_works: The strategy layers crowd control (0-2-4 Relentless Glue), heavy AoE splash (4-0-2 Tack / 2-0-4 Bomb), and endgame Tier 5 anti-blimp dominance inside a Jungle Drums / Stronger Stimulant buff pocket.

cargo.name: Cargo
cargo.lanes: Two distinct paths: ground path for bloons and water canal for MOABs
cargo.gimmick: MOAB-class bloons spawn from a separate water canal entrance directly toward the exit

Easy.overview: A busy commercial container port. Regular bloons travel along a winding land road, but MOABs spawn from a separate water channel with a much shorter path to the exit.
Easy.camo_handling: Sauda on the road handles Round 24. Buccaneer 0-2-2 Crow's Nest in the shipping canal covers all camo bloons.
Easy.lead_handling: Buccaneer 0-2-0 Hot Shot pops Leads on Round 28 with flaming grape volleys.
Easy.moab_handling: Buccaneer 3-2-0 Destroyer placed in the MOAB shipping canal + 0-3-2 Bomb Shooter intercepts the Round 40 MOAB immediately upon spawning.
Easy.why_it_works: Placing naval defenses in the water canal intercepts the MOAB at point-blank range as soon as it emerges.

carved.name: Carved
carved.lanes: Single path weaving through the carved face of a giant pumpkin
carved.gimmick: The path weaves in and out of the pumpkin's eyes, nose, and smiling mouth

Easy.overview: A festive Halloween map where the track winds through the carved features of a giant pumpkin. The center nose and mouth loops create exceptional overlap.
Easy.camo_handling: Sauda handles Round 24 camo green. Ninja 3-0-1 handles all subsequent camos.
Easy.lead_handling: Alchemist 2-0-0 buffs towers inside the pumpkin face to pop Leads on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Tack Shooter 2-0-4 Overdrive placed inside the nose cavity destroys the Round 40 MOAB as it loops through the mouth.
Easy.why_it_works: The central nose hollow touches track on three sides, giving radial towers immense efficiency.

Easy.best_hero_reason: Placing Sauda inside the carved pumpkin mouth grants coverage over both incoming and looped paths simultaneously.
Easy.hero_synergies: Wizard Monkey (0-2-4 Prince of Darkness) + Tack Zone (2-0-5)

Medium.overview: Medium difficulty tests defense scalability through Round 60 with standard 1.0x pricing. On Carved, Sauda secures our early game. The strategy expands into a 2-2-0 Village and 4-2-0 Alchemist buff engine, supporting Recursive Cluster and MOAB Assassin to conquer Round 50 Dual MOABs and shatter the Round 60 BFB.
Medium.camo_handling: Sauda and early detection handle R24/33/36. A 2-2-0 Monkey Village (Radar Scanner) is placed by Round 42, ensuring all towers pop R42 Camo Rainbows, R51 Camo ceramics, and R59 Camo Leads.
Medium.lead_handling: Acidic Mixture Dip (Alchemist 2-0-0) neutralizes early leads on R28/30. Recursive Cluster (2-0-4 Bomb) wipes Round 45 Fortified Leads and Round 59 Camo Leads under Village radar.
Medium.moab_handling: Round 40 MOAB is dispatched via single-target focus. Round 50 Dual MOABs are crushed by Stronger Stimulant buffed clusters. Round 60 BFB is neutralized via MOAB Assassin missile ability.
Medium.why_it_works: Jungle Drums + Stronger Stimulant delivers massive uptime and DPS multipliers across all towers. Radar Scanner gives full camo coverage so no specialized decamo micro is required.

Hard.overview: Hard difficulty demands comprehensive defense across 80 rounds with 1.08x prices. On Carved, Sauda secures our early survival starting on Round 3. We establish Ring of Fire and Recursive Cluster for Round 63/76 ceramic rushes, Relentless Glue for lockdown, and crown our defense with a Tier 5 blimp destroyer to vanquish the massive Round 80 ZOMG.
Hard.camo_handling: Early camo is dispatched via Sauda and Ninja detection. A 2-2-0 Monkey Village (Radar Scanner) is placed at the primary track hub, granting universal camo detection to all defenses for R59 Camo Leads and R78 Camo Ceramics.
Hard.lead_handling: Acidic Mixture Dip (Alchemist 2-0-0) neutralizes R28/30 Leads. Recursive Cluster (2-0-4) shreds R45 Fortified Leads. Village MIB/Radar ensures 100% lead-popping uptime on all attackers.
Hard.moab_handling: R40 MOAB and R50 Dual MOABs are conquered via focused single-target fire and Berserker Brew buffs. Round 60 BFB is shattered by targeted missile strikes. Round 80 ZOMG is systematically destroyed by Tier 5 firepower.
Hard.why_it_works: The strategy layers crowd control (0-2-4 Relentless Glue), heavy AoE splash (4-0-2 Tack / 2-0-4 Bomb), and endgame Tier 5 anti-blimp dominance inside a Jungle Drums / Stronger Stimulant buff pocket.
research_sources: Bloons TD 6 Advanced Waves & ZOMG Breakdown

castle_revenge.name: Castle Revenge
castle_revenge.lanes: Two simultaneous lanes crossing drawbridges and stone battlements
castle_revenge.gimmick: Medieval castle layout inspired by classic BTD5 Castle; stone walls and portcullises

Easy.why_it_works: Both lanes converge at the castle portcullis, creating an impenetrable bottleneck.

chutes.name: Chutes
chutes.lanes: Two alternating lanes down steep wooden water chutes
chutes.gimmick: Bloons alternate between the left and right chutes, requiring balanced defense across both tracks

Easy.overview: Two steep wooden chutes on a sandy beach. Bloons alternate sides every round. Placing towers in the central divide allows them to cover both tracks.
Easy.camo_handling: Quincy placed in the center hits camo from level 5. A 0-2-3 Dart Monkey in the center covers both lanes for Round 24 and 33.
Easy.lead_handling: Alchemist 2-0-0 or Bomb Shooter 0-3-0 in the central divide pops Leads on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Bomb Shooter 0-3-2 MOAB Mauler in the center divide + 2-0-3 Spike Factory at the bottom exit guarantees the MOAB is destroyed.
Easy.why_it_works: Towers placed in the middle ridge reach both the left and right chute tracks equally.

Easy.why_it_works: The drawbridge funnels 100% of bloons into a single narrow lane surrounded by land and water placement spots.

end_of_the_road.name: End of the Road
end_of_the_road.lanes: Single path traveling down a dusty road into a dead-end barricade
end_of_the_road.gimmick: The bloons travel straight down the road, loop around barricades, and turn back

Easy.overview: A dusty road leading to a dead-end construction roadblock. Bloons travel along the road, turn around at the barricade, and travel back along an adjacent path.
Easy.camo_handling: Sauda placed at the turnaround loop detects camo naturally from Round 1. Ninja 3-0-1 backs her up.
Easy.lead_handling: Alchemist 2-0-0 buffs towers at the turnaround to pop Leads on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Bomb Shooter 0-3-2 MOAB Mauler and Tack 2-0-4 Overdrive at the barricade destroy the MOAB upon arrival.
Easy.why_it_works: Bloons must turn 180 degrees at the end of the road. Towers placed at the dead-end hit bloons coming and going.

Easy.camo_handling: Sauda placed inside the loop spots camo on Round 24. Ninja 3-0-1 handles all subsequent camos.
Easy.lead_handling: Alchemist 2-0-0 placed next to Sauda melts Leads on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Tack Shooter 2-0-4 Overdrive at the bottom loop plus Sauda's Leaping Sword ability wipes out the Round 40 MOAB.
Easy.why_it_works: The loop around the ice block provides high concentration of track, allowing short-range high-DPS towers to maximize damage.

Medium.why_it_works: Jungle Drums + Stronger Stimulant delivers massive uptime and DPS multipliers across all towers. Radar Scanner gives full camo coverage so no specialized decamo micro is required.

Hard.overview: Hard difficulty demands comprehensive defense across 80 rounds with 1.08x prices. On Frozen Over, Sauda secures our early survival starting on Round 3. We establish Ring of Fire and Recursive Cluster for Round 63/76 ceramic rushes, Relentless Glue for lockdown, and crown our defense with a Tier 5 blimp destroyer to vanquish the massive Round 80 ZOMG.
Hard.camo_handling: Early camo is dispatched via Sauda and Ninja detection. A 2-2-0 Monkey Village (Radar Scanner) is placed at the primary track hub, granting universal camo detection to all defenses for R59 Camo Leads and R78 Camo Ceramics.
Hard.lead_handling: Acidic Mixture Dip (Alchemist 2-0-0) neutralizes R28/30 Leads. Recursive Cluster (2-0-4) shreds R45 Fortified Leads. Village MIB/Radar ensures 100% lead-popping uptime on all attackers.
Hard.moab_handling: R40 MOAB and R50 Dual MOABs are conquered via focused single-target fire and Berserker Brew buffs. Round 60 BFB is shattered by targeted missile strikes. Round 80 ZOMG is systematically destroyed by Tier 5 firepower.
Hard.why_it_works: The strategy layers crowd control (0-2-4 Relentless Glue), heavy AoE splash (4-0-2 Tack / 2-0-4 Bomb), and endgame Tier 5 anti-blimp dominance inside a Jungle Drums / Stronger Stimulant buff pocket.

geared.name: Geared
geared.lanes: Single path looping around the outer perimeter of a rotating giant central gear
geared.gimmick: The central giant gear rotates clockwise each round, repositioning all monkeys placed on it

Easy.camo_handling: Quincy covers early camos. Sniper 0-2-3 placed on the static outer wall detects camo across the entire map.
Easy.lead_handling: Sniper 1-0-0 on the outer wall or Bomb 0-3-0 pops Leads on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Sniper 3-0-2 Deadly Precision on Strong + Bomb Shooter 0-3-2 destroys the Round 40 MOAB regardless of gear position.
Easy.why_it_works: Global range towers on the stationary outer walls are completely unaffected by the gear rotation mechanic.

glacial_trail.name: Glacial Trail
glacial_trail.lanes: Single path through freezing ice caverns with periodic tower freezing
glacial_trail.gimmick: Severe cold mechanics freeze monkeys solid periodically, cycling which towers can attack

Easy.overview: A freezing glacial trail where biting arctic cold causes monkeys to periodically freeze solid and thaw in alternating cycles. Staggering placements ensures at least one tower is always active.
Easy.camo_handling: Quincy handles early camos. Sniper 0-2-3 placed on a separate ice shelf covers all camos when thawed.
Easy.lead_handling: Sniper 1-0-0 on the ice shelf or Bomb 0-3-0 handles Lead Bloons on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Sniper 3-0-2 Deadly Precision on Strong + Bomb Shooter 0-3-2 destroys the Round 40 MOAB.
Easy.why_it_works: Staggering tower placements between different ice shelves ensures continuous defense even when one tower freezes.

Easy.overview: A freezing glacial gorge with two alternating paths winding through ice bridges and icy melt pools. The central ice bridge chokepoint is the optimal defense zone.
Easy.camo_handling: Sauda placed on the ice bridge handles Round 24. Ninja 3-0-1 covers all subsequent camo bloons.
Easy.lead_handling: Alchemist 2-0-0 buffs ice bridge towers to pop Leads on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Ninja 4-0-1 Bloonjitsu + 3-2-0 Alchemist + 0-3-2 Bomb Shooter easily destroys the Round 40 MOAB in the gorge.
Easy.why_it_works: Both alternating lanes pass over the central ice bridge, creating a single chokepoint for all bloons.

monkey_meadow.name: Monkey Meadow

Easy.overview: The iconic starter map features a long, winding dirt track through an open grassy meadow with a prominent center loop. Towers placed in the inner bends maximize attack uptime as bloons circle around them.
Easy.camo_handling: Sauda hits camo naturally from Round 1. Ninja Monkey (0-0-0) placed on Round 18 adds redundant camo detection well before Round 24 (single green camo) and Round 33 (camo reds/yellows).
Easy.lead_handling: Alchemist (2-0-0 Acidic Mixture Dip) placed on Round 26 grants lead-popping to Sauda and Ninja, easily neutralizing Round 28 and 30 Lead Bloons.
Easy.moab_handling: Bomb Shooter upgraded to 0-3-2 (MOAB Mauler) placed at the center bend on Round 36 tears through the Round 40 MOAB hull, while Sauda and 4-0-1 Ninja shred the ceramic children.
Easy.why_it_works: The central loop allows high-damage melee and short-range towers to hit bloons twice. Sauda + 4-0-1 Ninja + 3-2-0 Alchemist provides top-tier pierce, tracking shurikens, and lead buff.

polyphemus.name: Polyphemus
polyphemus.lanes: Single path spiraling around a cyclopean eye pit with dynamic water levels

Easy.overview: A mythical volcanic eye caldera where bloons spiral around a giant pupil. The central water basin drains and refills throughout the game.
Easy.camo_handling: Sauda placed on the solid outer rim handles Round 24. Ninja 3-0-1 provides complete camo safety.
Easy.lead_handling: Alchemist 2-0-0 placed on the outer rim buffs towers to pop Leads on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Tack Shooter 2-0-4 Overdrive + 0-3-2 Bomb Shooter destroys the Round 40 MOAB as it spirals.
Easy.why_it_works: Placing core defenses on the permanent solid stone rim avoids all water-drain mechanics while maintaining full coverage.

Medium.why_it_works: Jungle Drums + Stronger Stimulant delivers massive uptime and DPS multipliers across all towers. Radar Scanner gives full camo coverage so no specialized decamo micro is required.

Hard.overview: Hard difficulty demands comprehensive defense across 80 rounds with 1.08x prices. On Workshop, Sauda secures our early survival starting on Round 3. We establish Ring of Fire and Recursive Cluster for Round 63/76 ceramic rushes, Relentless Glue for lockdown, and crown our defense with a Tier 5 blimp destroyer to vanquish the massive Round 80 ZOMG.
Hard.camo_handling: Early camo is dispatched via Sauda and Ninja detection. A 2-2-0 Monkey Village (Radar Scanner) is placed at the primary track hub, granting universal camo detection to all defenses for R59 Camo Leads and R78 Camo Ceramics.
Hard.lead_handling: Acidic Mixture Dip (Alchemist 2-0-0) neutralizes R28/30 Leads. Recursive Cluster (2-0-4) shreds R45 Fortified Leads. Village MIB/Radar ensures 100% lead-popping uptime on all attackers.
Hard.moab_handling: R40 MOAB and R50 Dual MOABs are conquered via focused single-target fire and Berserker Brew buffs. Round 60 BFB is shattered by targeted missile strikes. Round 80 ZOMG is systematically destroyed by Tier 5 firepower.
Hard.why_it_works: The strategy layers crowd control (0-2-4 Relentless Glue), heavy AoE splash (4-0-2 Tack / 2-0-4 Bomb), and endgame Tier 5 anti-blimp dominance inside a Jungle Drums / Stronger Stimulant buff pocket.

x_factor.name: X Factor
x_factor.lanes: Four alternating diagonal lanes crossing in an X pattern
x_factor.gimmick: Bloons enter from 4 separate diagonal corners and cross at the center

Easy.overview: Four diagonal paths crossing in an X shape. Bloons enter from all four corners, but every path passes through the central intersection.
Easy.camo_handling: Quincy covers early camos from the central cross. Sniper 0-2-3 placed in the center covers all 4 lanes.
Easy.lead_handling: Sniper 1-0-0 or Bomb Shooter 0-3-0 handles Lead Bloons on Round 28.
Easy.moab_handling: Sniper 3-0-2 Deadly Precision on Strong + Bomb Shooter 0-3-2 destroys the Round 40 MOAB at the center intersection.
Easy.why_it_works: The central crossway is the common intersection for all four diagonal tracks.
